reproduction_target: Reproduce the two-step decontamination pipeline (competitive mapping + allelic depth ratio filtering) and the downstream species delineation / introgression inferences (SNP calls, MDS, ADMIXTURE K=9, COI ML phylogeny) from the RADseq and COI data of 1,171 Lasius individuals. Wet-lab collection, DNA extraction, COI barcoding and RAD library preparation are out of scope (W).
granularity_note: One step per named tool/analysis invocation in the Methods prose (no workflow file exists; no code repository is stated in the paper). 16 computational steps, 4 wet-lab steps. Stage-1 prose triage only: no code was read, no artifact was fetched.

steps.label: Field sampling of 3,173 Lasius workers (Operation Fourmis citizen science + structured sampling, Vaud 2019); morphological identification following Seifert (2018)
DNA extraction from three legs per worker and COI barcoding (LepF1/LepR1) outsourced to CCDB (790 samples) and AllGenetics (381 samples)
RAD library preparation (EcoRI + MseI digestion, custom barcode adaptors, 16 PCR cycles, BluePippin 280-430 bp size selection) per Brelsford et al. (2016)
Sequencing on eight Illumina HiSeq 2500 lanes (single end, 150 bases)
Demultiplexing: stacks v2.53 process_radtags with options -c -q -r -t 143
Read mapping to Lasius niger reference genome (BioProject PRJNA1159026, Masson et al. 2024) with BWA v0.7.17 mem
Alignment file formatting and summary statistics with samtools v1.15.1
Locus building: stacks gstacks with --phasing-dont-prune-hets --ignore-pe-reads
stacks populations with --write-single-snp (one SNP per RAD locus)
SNP filtering with vcftools 0.1.14 (min genotype depth 8, minor allele count 2, locus present in >=75% of individuals; individuals with >50% missing loci excluded)

Competitive mapping: reads mapped with BWA v0.7.17 mem to a concatenation of the L. niger genome and ant genomes of seven other genera (Camponotus, Formica, Leptothorax, Myrmica, Tapinoma, Temnothorax, Tetramorium; Romiguier et al. 2022 and BioProjects PRJNA445978, PRJNA819254, PRJNA533534)
Custom R v4.2.1 code assigning each read to its target genome in the alignment file and emitting the list of read names mapping primarily or secondarily to the Lasius genome
Read filtering with BBMap v38.63 filterbyname.sh using the retained read-name list and include=t

Allelic depth ratio (ADR) filtering with a custom R v4.2.1 script using vcfR v1.14.0: expected ADR distribution simulated from a binomial with locus depth; individuals above the top 5% percentile discarded; genotypes above the top 25% percentile corrected to homozygous
Artificial haploidization of the competitively mapped dataset with a custom R v4.2.1 script using vcfR v1.14.0 (minor-read allele removed; ties broken at random)
MultiDimensional Scaling (MDS) of SNP calls with R package MASS (R v4.2.1)
ADMIXTURE (no version stated): 10 replicates for K = 1..15, best K and replicate chosen by cross-validation error (K=9); haploid dataset run with --haploid="*"
Visualization / run selection of ADMIXTURE replicates with pong (no version stated); 'most representative run' chosen
COI sequence alignment with mafft v7.481, L-INS-i algorithm
Maximum Likelihood COI phylogeny with IQ-TREE v2.2.0.5 using ModelFinder Plus and 1000 UltraFast Bootstraps
Hybrid/introgression calling from ADMIXTURE ancestry proportions (individuals with <=98.4375% main-species ancestry classified as of hybrid ancestry)

gaps.how_to_close: Deposit raw RADseq reads and COI sequences in SRA/ENA with an accession quoted in the paper; deposit the pipeline (competitive-mapping read assignment, ADR filtering, haploidization) in a public repository with a version tag or Zenodo DOI.

gaps.missing: The three steps that constitute the paper's own methodological contribution are performed by 'a custom script in R v4.2.1' that is never linked or deposited. Only the algorithm is described in prose.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the custom R scripts (and the exact vcfR calls) alongside the paper.

gaps.how_to_close: Release the scripts with a fixed random seed shown as consumed.

gaps.how_to_close: State exact versions, or ship a conda/renv lock.

Which assembly/version was used for each of the seven genera is not resolvable from prose. No workflow exists to classify as env_capture_class A/B/C - left n/a per stage-1 rule.
gaps.how_to_close: Give per-genome assembly accession + version, or ship a download rule pinning each assembly.

gaps.missing: Stochastic steps without a stated seed: binomial simulation of the expected ADR distribution, random tie-breaking during haploidization, 10 ADMIXTURE replicates, 1000 UltraFast Bootstraps. Distributional match only.
Sampling, DNA extraction/COI barcoding (outsourced to CCDB and AllGenetics), RAD library preparation and Illumina sequencing are wet-lab; excluded from |S| as OOS.
gaps.how_to_close: n/a - out of scope for computational reproducibility.
